heldFunction.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.app_access_held(p_type text, p_id bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.auto_accounts a WHERE
    CASE p_type WHEN 'account' THEN a.id=p_id WHEN 'staff' THEN a.staff_id=p_id ELSE false END
    AND (a.runtime_operation_claim_token IS NOT NULL OR a.status='đang chạy'
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.auto_campaigns c WHERE (c.account_id=a.id OR c.secondary_account_id=a.id)
        AND (c.status='đang chạy' OR c.runtime_claim_token IS NOT NULL OR c.runtime_unit_token IS NOT NULL))))
$function$

existingCampaignIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_auto_campaigns_last_run_at ON public.auto_campaigns USING btree (staff_id, last_run_at) WHERE (is_delete = false)

CREATE INDEX idx_sms_campaigns_account_status_schedule ON public.auto_campaigns USING btree (account_id, action_id, status, schedule, id) WHERE ((COALESCE(is_delete, false) = false) AND (action_id = 'sms_send'::text))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auto_campaigns_pkey ON public.auto_campaigns USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX auto_campaigns_staff_id_idx ON public.auto_campaigns USING btree (staff_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_auto_campaigns_control_idempotency ON public.auto_campaigns USING btree (staff_id, control_idempotency_key) WHERE (control_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL)

CREATE INDEX idx_auto_campaigns_data_group ON public.auto_campaigns USING btree (data_group_id, status, schedule, id) WHERE ((data_target_source_mode = 'data_group'::text) AND (COALESCE(is_delete, false) = false))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_auto_campaigns_creation_bundle_child ON public.auto_campaigns USING btree (creation_bundle_id, creation_bundle_child_index) WHERE ((creation_bundle_id IS NOT NULL) AND (creation_bundle_child_index IS NOT NULL))
CREATE INDEX idx_auto_campaigns_secondary_account_id ON public.auto_campaigns USING btree (secondary_account_id) WHERE (secondary_account_id IS NOT NULL)
